title: Bicycle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#4FE3C1' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='3' fill='#4FE3C1'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='3' fill='#7FD4FF'/>
  <!-- spokes rear -->
  <line x1='26' y1='57' x2='26' y2='87' stroke='#4FE3C1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='11' y1='72' x2='41' y2='72' stroke='#4FE3C1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='15' y1='61' x2='37' y2='83' stroke='#4FE3C1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='61' x2='15' y2='83' stroke='#4FE3C1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- spokes front -->
  <line x1='74' y1='57' x2='74' y2='87' stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='72' x2='89' y2='72' stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='61' x2='85' y2='83' stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='85' y1='61' x2='63' y2='83' stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- frame -->
  <line x1='26' y1='72' x2='42' y2='50' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='50' x2='62' y2='50' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='50' x2='74' y2='72' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='50' x2='58' y2='72' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='72' x2='26' y2='72' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='72' x2='74' y2='72' stroke='#FFD447' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- seat post and seat -->
  <line x1='42' y1='50' x2='40' y2='40' stroke='#FF8A5C' stroke-width='3'/>
  <rect x='33' y='35' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FF8A5C'/>
  <!-- handlebar post and bars -->
  <line x1='62' y1='50' x2='66' y2='36' stroke='#FF8A5C' stroke-width='3'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='36' x2='74' y2='34' stroke='#FF8A5C' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pedals -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='4' fill='#FF8A5C'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the frame -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='7' fill='#4FE3C1'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='1.4' fill='#103B2E'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='42' r='1.4' fill='#103B2E'/>
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 50 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#103B2E' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
